title: Tanzania Crop Survey
description: This dataset was collected by YouthMappers students in three regions of Tanzania: Arusha, Dodoma and Mwanza. It includes estimated field centroid coordinates, primary crop, secondary crop and estimated field size. The data was collected in a 2023 pilot study supported by USDA’s Foreign Agricultural Service and the USAID/GeoCenter to see if university students could conduct field visits and collect ground-truth data for training machine or deep learning models applied to remotely sensed imagery.
